proposed_registry_entry_for_shared_owner.description: Qualify the exact Book System Version and Rollback subject: immutable complete-state snapshots and governed-object version lineage; exact parent and version-ledger compare-and-swap; append-only history preservation; rollback as RESTORE_AS_NEW_SUCCESSOR rather than history rewrite; current rights/privacy/dependency/binding/author revalidation; replay and idempotency conflict safety; atomic receipt/outbox identity; direct lifecycle-status mutation denial; exact ingestion of already-committed qualified parent successors using pre/post authority-receipt identity; and no synthesized author, publication, provider-canonical-write, document-engine or production authority. PASS is exact-SHA only and does not transfer prior Book qualifications.

shared_owner_checks_before_registration: Confirm the qualifier path exists on the intended exact subject and executes without network/private-data dependency.
Confirm the qualification is focused, subject-sourced and compatible with current A-01 policy/registry schema.
Confirm no direct self-hosted Book workflow bypass is introduced; execution must route through the canonical A-01 gateway.
Confirm the hosted-passing subject remains immutable. If any subject bytes required by qualification change, require fresh hosted PASS on the changed exact SHA before authoritative A-01.
Preserve all prior failed/passing Version/Rollback subjects as historical evidence rather than relabeling them.

after_registration.required_action: Invoke the canonical A-01 control-plane gateway with qualification_id BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 and the exact intended subject SHA, then adjudicate the receipt and evidence artifact.
after_registration.pass_route: Close BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 only on exact authoritative PASS and revalidate Book control before advancing to BOOK-SYSTEM-AUTHOR-DECISION-QUEUE-001.
after_registration.failure_route: Classify SUBJECT_FAILURE, INFRA_FAILURE or CONTROL_PLANE_FAILURE from the receipt; repair only the proven boundary under its canonical owner.

book_lane_authority_statement: This file is a handoff request/evidence packet only. It does not modify or pre-authorize the shared A-01 registry, policy, gateway or qualification standing.
